4. Open questions for suppliers

  1. Supplier A (EM-1001): Does D-01 still apply to lots shipped after March 2026? If not, please provide a current mine origin statement.
  2. Supplier B (EM-2040): Please identify the facility and country where the samarium and cobalt were mined and refined, with a supporting document.
  3. Supplier C (EM-3310): Please confirm the separation facility named in D-05 and whether an alternative non-covered source is available for future lots.
  4. Supplier C (EM-3310): Please identify the mine of origin for the rare earth feedstock.

5. Limits of this pack

  • This pack records what supplier documents say. Lodeline does not audit facilities or independently test materials.
  • Statuses describe documentation only. They are not a determination of compliance, exemption or acceptance.
  • Lodeline provides supply-chain documentation and analysis, not legal advice or government certification. Applicability, exceptions, and acceptance depend on the contract and the responsible reviewer.
  • No controlled technical data, drawings or export-controlled information was used.
